description: Emphasizes Layer 2/3 concepts and the data plane. Review of computer communications and networks. Switch & Router Architectures, Traffic Management and Traffic Engineering, Data and Control Plane (Virtual Private Networks, MPLS), QoS routing aspects and Protocols. Optical Networks.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete 1 of:
    • CSC361 - Computer Communications and Networks (1.5)
    • CSC450 - Computer Communications and Networks (1.5)
    • CENG460 - Communication Networks (1.5)
    • ECE363 - Communication Networks (1.5)
    • ECE458 - Communication Networks (1.5)
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 467, CSC 567.
  • May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
title: Switching, Network Traffic and Quality of Service
